items.html: *And know that there are two kinds of couplings in Aba and Ima of Atzilut: one, when they are on high, equal in their stature; and two, when Ima squats upon the children, so that her NNH are clothed within ZA to give him Mochin, as is known. And then Ima must lower herself down to enter within ZA. And behold, of these two couplings, the first is the secret of Aba and Ima, and the second is the secret of YESHSUT. Only that we need to speak in a hidden manner, and you will understand by yourself.
